name: Timeline Shorts Builder
summary: Create an editable vertical Draft with uncropped native-size media above an optimized, export-safe Selects-style timeline.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel support, generated-media authoring, and the host FileSystem, SequenceRepository, and SequenceEdit adapters. Worker and OffscreenCanvas support are optional; the panel falls back to sequential UI-thread image conversion. Released-version and Windows/Linux compatibility are unverified.

ko.name: 타임라인 숏폼 빌더
ko.summary: 크롭 없이 원본 크기 그대로 배치한 미디어 아래에, 내보내기에 안전하도록 최적화한 Selects 스타일 타임라인을 넣은 편집 가능한 세로 초안을 만듭니다.
